title: Attio logo grid
description: Customer wordmarks in a hairline grid of pale-grey 96px cells inside the page frame: two rows of five on desktop, three rows of two on phones. Cells that link to a story carry a tiny ↗ in the corner and darken a shade on hover.
notes: give ten logos; phones show the first six
the frame's side lines appear from lg, matching the other attio blocks
